title: Otto and the Sleepy Moon
blurb: Otto the otter helps the Moon find its way to bed.
hook: Even the Moon needs tucking in.
coverAlt: Otto the otter floating on his back on a calm river, holding up a tiny glowing crescent moon

cast.name: Otto
cast.look: Otto: a small, round river otter with glossy chocolate-brown fur, a cream face and tummy, tiny round ears, long whiskers and a knitted mustard-yellow scarf.

cast.name: The Moon
cast.look: The Moon: a small crescent moon the size of a beach ball, glowing soft butter-yellow, with sleepy half-closed eyes and rosy cheeks.

world: A calm river at night between willow trees, fireflies, smooth stepping stones.
style: Soft painterly 3D picture-book illustration, warm moonlight, deep blue night, no text.

pages.heading: Up Too Late
pages.text:
“Psst,” whispered someone. Otto looked up… and up.

The Moon was sitting in the willow tree — wide awake at 9 o’clock!
pages.imageAlt: Otto the otter on a riverbank looking up at the Moon sitting in a willow tree

art.shot: Low angle from the riverbank, looking up into the willow.
art.prompt: Otto stands on a mossy riverbank, head tilted back, looking up at The Moon perched in the branches of a willow tree. Fireflies drift around.

pages.heading: Goodnight
pages.text:
Otto floated on his back and sang the Moon a slow, slow song.

By the end, they were both asleep.
pages.imageAlt: Otto floating asleep on the river while the Moon dozes above

art.shot: Wide, calm, high angle over the river.
art.prompt: Otto floats asleep on his back on the still river, scarf trailing, while The Moon dozes low in the sky above the willows.
